commands.command:
set -eu
printf '#!/bin/sh\nprintf executed\\n\n' > /tmp/noexec-probe
chmod 755 /tmp/noexec-probe
set +e
/tmp/noexec-probe >/tmp/noexec.out 2>/tmp/noexec.err
exec_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'noexec_probe_rc=%s\n' "$exec_rc"
printf 'noexec_probe_error='; cat /tmp/noexec.err
mknod /tmp/nodev-probe c 1 3
set +e
dd if=/tmp/nodev-probe of=/dev/null count=1 >/tmp/nodev.out 2>/tmp/nodev.err
nodev_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'nodev_probe_rc=%s\n' "$nodev_rc"
printf 'nodev_probe_error='; cat /tmp/nodev.err
rm -f /tmp/noexec-probe /tmp/noexec.out /tmp/noexec.err /tmp/nodev-probe /tmp/nodev.out /tmp/nodev.err
[ "$exec_rc" -ne 0 ]
[ "$nodev_rc" -ne 0 ]

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
for target in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  opts=$(findmnt -T "$target" -no OPTIONS)
  fstype=$(findmnt -T "$target" -no FSTYPE)
  printf '%s fstype=%s options=%s\n' "$target" "$fstype" "$opts"
  [ "$fstype" = tmpfs ]
  printf '%s\n' "$opts" | grep -Eq '(^|,)noexec(,|$)'
  printf '%s\n' "$opts" | grep -Eq '(^|,)nosuid(,|$)'
  printf '%s\n' "$opts" | grep -Eq '(^|,)nodev(,|$)'
done
printf 'persistent_entries:\n'
awk '$2=="/tmp" || $2=="/dev/shm" {print}' /etc/fstab
[ "$(awk '$2=="/tmp" && $3=="tmpfs" && $4 ~ /(^|,)noexec(,|$)/ && $4 ~ /(^|,)nosuid(,|$)/ && $4 ~ /(^|,)nodev(,|$)/ {n++} END {print n+0}' /etc/fstab)" -eq 1 ]
[ "$(awk '$2=="/dev/shm" && $3=="tmpfs" && $4 ~ /(^|,)noexec(,|$)/ && $4 ~ /(^|,)nosuid(,|$)/ && $4 ~ /(^|,)nodev(,|$)/ {n++} END {print n+0}' /etc/fstab)" -eq 1 ]
printf 'mount_hardening_baseline=PASS\n'

commands.command:
set -eu
for target in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  probe="$target/hardening-probe"
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nprintf executed\\n\n' > "$probe"
  chmod 755 "$probe"
  set +e
  "$probe" >/dev/null 2>"$target/noexec.err"
  exec_rc=$?
  set -e
  printf '%s noexec_rc=%s error=' "$target" "$exec_rc"; cat "$target/noexec.err"
  rm -f "$probe" "$target/noexec.err"
  [ "$exec_rc" -ne 0 ]

  device="$target/nodev-probe"
  mknod "$device" c 1 3
  set +e
  dd if="$device" of=/dev/null count=1 >/dev/null 2>"$target/nodev.err"
  nodev_rc=$?
  set -e
  printf '%s nodev_rc=%s error=' "$target" "$nodev_rc"; cat "$target/nodev.err"
  rm -f "$device" "$target/nodev.err"
  [ "$nodev_rc" -ne 0 ]
done
printf 'post_restart_behavior=PASS\n'
